title: Instant Pot Chicken and Noodles
summary: This Instant Pot chicken and noodles dish is your solution to a busy weeknight dinner! Minimal prep work and ready in 30 minutes!
ingredients: 1 pound chicken breast or thigh, cut into bite-sized pieces
1-2 teaspoons minced garlic or garlic powder
steps: Set instant pot to saute function. Add butter, chicken, and onion (if using) and saute for about 2-3 minutes, until the outside of chicken gets seared. Add garlic and Italian seasoning. Give it a good stir and hit CANCEL.
Add broth, scraping up any bits that stick to the bottom.
Add pasta then veggies on top. There is no need to stir.

Close lid and set valve to sealing pressure. Pressure cook on high for 5 minutes. Note: it will take about 15 minutes to come to pressure. Once it beeps, quick release by turning the vent to venting position.
